ops-broadcast: :loudspeaker: Scheduling: grace-deg-score failover + load validation on Wed 2026-07-20 01:30-02:15 UTC. Purpose: validate new graceful-degradation score (GDS) and tiered SLA behavior during partial region loss.

ops-broadcast: Plan: ramp synthetic traffic to 2.2x over 8m, trigger regional shift (move ~40% away), then simulate 25% node drain. We'll observe GDS and fallback rates.

harper: New metric notes: GDS is a composite 0-100 where lower is worse; primary abort if GDS drops >15 pts for 6m. Also watch client error skew by SDK.

lee: Safety gates: abort if global error delta >2% for 6m OR p99 > baseline*2 for 10m. Deploy-bot will pause between steps and emit events.

oncall: I'll be primary. If you can't watch, please reply here so we can arrange coverage. Post-test: 3-bullet summary and metrics snapshot.

deploy-bot: Job queued: gds-failover-20260720. Canary region: us-east-1. Notifications to #ops-log.

ops-broadcast: Acks appreciated. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gds-failover. Will update this thread during the window.
